title: Keep a post-fix debug record for every checkpoint
summary: Make each repair reviewable from its original failure through the focused fix, a known-good control, and its public runner result at the repair SHA.

origin.source: 2026-11-19 · README HQ planning discussion and the documented post-fix debug gate.

benefits: Lets a new session see what was reproduced, what passed after the fix, and what still needs verification before review.
risks: A run link without the exact SHA, attempt, job, and executed checks can be mistaken for acceptance evidence.

evidence.claim: The follow-up plan states the required debug pass, exact public-runner proof, and pre-advance review.
